Roster hygiene

Records with no attendance

—

Children carried on the attendance report who did not attend a single day that month. Twelve in January, four in August. Each one is either a child to win back or a record to close.

Starts & stops

Month-to-month movement

—
MonthStartedStoppedNetEnrolled

Derived from the attendance report: a child counts as started in the first month they attend and stopped when a month of attendance is followed by none. A long hospitalization looks the same as a discharge here, so treat stops as a prompt to check, not as a removal record.
